hypothesis: For the same model, settings, tools, task and exact base revision, automatically injected source-locked pi-atdd graph guidance (condition B) increases the number of independently accepted changes relative to no injection (condition A), without increasing false-green claims.

conditions.graph: identical flags plus exactly `-e <frozen pi-atdd extension snapshot>/extensions/atdd.ts`

piFlags: --mode json --approve --no-session --no-mcp --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-context-files --no-themes --no-extensions [-e ext] --provider P --model M --thinking T (default built-in tools: read,bash,edit,write)

reviewer.blinding: opaque submission id; no condition label; coder report redacted of ATDD/convention identifiers; diff shown verbatim (leakage scanned and reported)

tierRationale: weak = smallest calibrated tool-capable candidate (claude-haiku-4-5; it executed real tools but produced an incorrect calibration value); strong = claude-opus-5-5. Both coders on the anthropic provider; reviewer on a different provider (openai-codex).
fixtureTreeNote: fixture/ in this directory is byte-identical to the base revision tree
oracleDisclosure: Held-out oracle and reference solutions are kept outside every trial and outside this repository until all trials finish; only their SHA-256 digests are committed here, the files are published afterwards.

outcomeDefinition.accepted: integrity valid (verifyTrial: clean, exact HEAD, base ancestor, only allowed paths) AND visible acceptance passes AND held-out oracle passes AND blind reviewer verdict ACCEPT
outcomeDefinition.falseGreen: blind reviewer judges the coder report claims success AND held-out oracle fails

threshold.unit: matched pair (same tier, task, base); 6 pairs = 2 tiers x 3 runnable tasks
threshold.net: net = sum over valid pairs of (graph accepted - baseline accepted)
threshold.BENEFIT: net >= +2 AND graph false-greens <= baseline false-greens
threshold.REGRESSION: net <= -2 OR graph false-greens >= baseline false-greens + 2
threshold.overall: Overall D008 verdict is INCOMPLETE if any preregistered prerequisite is missing (independent evaluator authentication, T4-COORD unrun, either tier unqualified or invalid pair); the observed directional result is still reported. INVALID if the harness premises fail.
threshold.caveat: n = 6 single-replicate pairs; this threshold is a decision rule for this pilot, not a statistical significance test.

budgets.stopRules: stop and report if a trial loops, exceeds the timeout, or a provider rate-limits; failed attempts are preserved, never re-run in place

counterbalancing: LCG PRNG seeded with parseInt(baseRevision[0:8],16): per-pair condition order, pair order after the smoke pair, and opaque trial ids

unrunScenarios.reason: Protocol: 'implement after PLT-66; do not simulate a passing runtime integration now'. No JJ exact-head validator is available to the Pi agent in pi-atdd at the base revision, so the scenario cannot be run without inventing the dependency.
